children: OTTAWA, Sept 14 (Reuters) - Canada's annual inflation rate remained at 3.0% in August as slower gasoline price increases were offset by more expensive travel tours and higher rent, Statistics Canada said on Monday.    Analysts had expected the annual inflation rate to hold at 3.0%, as it was in July.

Percent changes                                          Month-on-month        Year-on-year                               Aug      Jul         Aug     Jul    CPI - all items           -0.1     +0.5        +3.0    +3.0    CPI - common               n/a      n/a        +2.6    +2.7    CPI - median               n/a      n/a        +2.0    +2.0    CPI - trim                 n/a      n/a        +1.9    +1.9    Bank of Canada core       +0.1     +0.2        +2.4    +2.3    All items ex food/energy   0.0     +0.4        +2.1    +1.9    Goods                     -0.3     +0.3        +3.4    +3.7    Services                  +0.2     +0.7        +2.8    +2.5    Energy                    -0.2     +2.5       +15.4   +16.6
Seasonally adjusted       +0.2     +0.2         n/a     n/a    Core CPI, SA              +0.2     +0.2         n/a     n/a

NOTE: Analysts in a Reuters survey had forecast August CPI to rise to 3.0% annualized, and to be flat on the month.   (Reporting by Dale Smith; Editing by Promit Mukherjee) ((promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
